newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Mexico Q3 margin may fall sharply - Accival.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Mexico Q3 margin may fall sharply - Accival.

text.p: Mexican mining company Grupo Mexico's operating margin could fall by 13 percentage points in the third quarter, compared with the same quarter last year, according to estimates by the brokerage house Accival.

"The world copper price fell from $1.30 per pound in April to $0.95 per pound in June, so we expect the company's third quarter results to reflect these considerably lower prices," said Accival equity analysts Arturo Espinosa and Rafael Pablo Urquia in a research report.
Grupo Mexico is Mexico's biggest copper producer and supplies about 95 percent of domestic needs.

Banacci estimates an operating margin of 32 percent for the third quarter ending September this year compared with 45 percent during the year-ago quarter. An operating margin of 32 percent would also be six percentage points down from the second quarter.

The brokerage expects Grupo Mexico shares to be trading at 29 pesos by the close of this year, which would provide returns below those estimated for the market in general, due to the poor outlook for world copper prices. Accival does not issue ratings on stocks.
"We feel (copper) prices have considerable downside potential, due mainly to the growth in world supply as big projects start up with considerably enhanced production capacity," the analysts added.
